name: NBA BOUNCE
description:
Players of any age and level can learn the basics and play in style as they shoot, dunk, and block. 



Ready to step onto the court with your favorite team? If you’ve ever wanted to play for the NBA, or see what it’s like to hoop for the other team, now you can! Dribble, pass and slam dunk your way to victory in this action-packed basketball game.



Lead the way from the East Coast to the West Coast, choosing from 30 official NBA teams like the Boston Celtics, Chicago Bulls, New York Knicks, Golden State Warriors, Los Angeles Lakers, Denver Nuggets, and more.



Choose an Eastern or Western Conference.



Jump into the shenanigans with your favorite team mascot in Party Mode. 



Test your skills on team-themed courts, feel the crowd cheering you on from the stands, and even bring the energetic mascots from the sidelines into the game.



Choose your game mode and work on your lay-ups in Training, compete in a Full Season or Party playing Ball Pop and more. 



Go against the shot clock! Can you make the winning basket before the buzzer? Dribble, shoot, and block shots as you work up the ranks from rookie to pro. Unlock unique jerseys, sneakers, basketballs, mascots, and more. Earn amazing gear to add to your collection in the Locker Room. The ball’s in your court!



Have fun together while improving your game for tournaments, solo or with up to 4 players in local co-op. Play to your strengths with simple controls and different game modes, it’s perfect for all ages.



Go to Practice, play a Quick Match, head to the top in the Playoffs, and jump into the mayhem in Party Mode. Whether scoring buzzer-beaters or making awesome slam dunks, pick up and play to experience basketball in a fun, new way, practising your moves with the big leagues.

  • FUN & EASY HOOP PLAY: Players of any age and level can learn the basics and play in style as they shoot, dunk, and block. 
  • CO-OP ON THE COURTS: Shoot hoops with family and friends and amp up the challenge with up to 4 players. 
  • PRACTICE YOUR MOVES: Choose your game mode and work on your lay-ups in Training, compete in a Full Season or Party playing Ball Pop and more. 
  • MASCOT MAYHEM: Jump into the shenanigans with your favorite team mascot in Party Mode. 
  • BUILD YOUR PERFECT LINEUP: Choose an Eastern or Western Conference.
